items.title: Google Adopts Pyrefly for Faster, More Accurate Python Type Checking
items.summaryShort: Google Adopts Pyrefly for Faster, More Accurate Python Type Checking. Google has replaced its long-standing Python type checker, Pytype, with Pyrefly, an open-source tool originally developed by Meta.

items.title: Amazon Acquires DuckLabs and Integrates DuckDB in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
items.summaryShort: Amazon Acquires DuckLabs and Integrates DuckDB in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Amazon has acquired DuckLabs, the company behind the analytical database DuckDB.

items.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
items.summaryShort: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns. A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

items.title: TikTok permanently bans ‘Musk’ documentary advertising account
items.summaryShort: TikTok permanently bans ‘Musk’ documentary advertising account. A four-hour documentary about Elon Musk continues to meet resistance from social media platforms.

items.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
items.summaryShort: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings. The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.
